suggestions.text: We can now bring our right hand towards the ground.
around the navel and with our right hand we can give a bandhan around the void
We can now bring our left hand and place it on our right heart and this is the center of righteousness,
We can now also bring our right hand to the Agnya and rest our head slightly in our hand.
Now with the right hand we can bring up our Kundalini through the central channel.
Slowly towards the Sahasrara chakra, the seventh chakra, the fontanel bone area.
We can also bring our hand above our head and see if we can feel our kundalini
